candidate_budget_unit: regional identities; each is decoded by both unchanged complete-response providers
pairing: all ordered pairs within a query; equal scene and query weights
inference: antisymmetric pairwise gain against candidate zero; select one intact response
calibration: single margin, maximize scene macro gain subject to nonnegative gain in each of three separate calibration rooms; reject all allowed
transfer_control: same proposals, probabilities and per-view all-teacher score multiset, jointly permuted query-to-region association
development_gate: positive scene-macro gain against baseline and query_blind and permuted; at least three of four rooms nonnegative
benchmark_gate: all-five feedback required before promotion; no per-benchmark margins or winner stitching
provider_training_overlap: the frozen decoder was also trained on these 22 fit rooms; calibration and development are scene-disjoint from decoder fit
